Hi Alice & Tom —

Thanks again for taking the product demo earlier today. Quick recap and agreed next steps: 

Summary from our call:
- Primary use: customer support summarization + reranking for search.
- Expected monthly token volume: ~5M tokens initially, scaling to ~25M over 6 months.
- SLOs: p95 latency target <350ms for single-turn generation.

Procurement / legal items you flagged:
1) Preferred commercial path: you mentioned procurement typically wants a PO (vendor onboarding + 3rd party attestation) but are open to marketplace if it simplifies payment. Can you confirm PO vs card vs marketplace?
2) Security gating: you requested SOC 2 attestation, our DPA, and answers to a short vendor security questionnaire.
3) Timeline: procurement indicated ~2–3 week onboarding once vendor packet and SOC2 are provided.

What I’ll send after this email:
- Redwood SOC 2 Type II attestation (attached)
- Our standard DPA (attached)
- Vendor packet (vendor form + W9 / supplier info) — attached as a zip.

Can you confirm the procurement contact (is procurement@acme.com the right inbox?) and whether Acme would prefer to transact via marketplace listing (AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace) vs an issued PO to Redwood? If PO: any special PO terms (net-30/45, special tax or PO number process) we should follow?

Next steps we proposed on the call:
- You: share vendor onboarding questionnaire & any required attachments for legal (Procurement team).
- Us: follow up with SOC2 + DPA + vendor packet (attached).
- Internal: align on acceptance of PO and any required contractual exceptions.

Attaching: Redwood_SOC2_Attestation.pdf; Redwood_DPA_v3.1.pdf; Redwood_Vendor_Packet.zip

Happy to hop on a short call with procurement if that helps speed things up.

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for sending the docs. Quick answers from our side: 

1) Procurement path: Our default is PO (Net-30). We use a vendor onboarding packet plus SOC2 evidence. Marketplace purchases are acceptable for small purchases but for multi-tenant integrations at this scale Procurement prefers a formal PO so we can track spend.

2) Docs: procurement@acme.com is correct. I’ve just uploaded your packet to our vendor portal, but Procurement will need SOC2 attestation and an executed DPA. Also we require either a completed vendor security questionnaire or a profile in our SupplySecurity tool.

3) Timeline: If we get SOC2 + DPA + vendor packet this week, Procurement thinks onboarding can be completed in ~10 business days (subject to questionnaire outcome).

Tom (cc’d) is the procurement lead — Tom, can you confirm whether any additional tax/PO fields are required on the Redwood order form?

Thanks,
